package.description: Secure two-way communication between clinicians and patients, integrated with EMIS Web and SystmOne clinical systems.

en-US.description: Secure two-way communication between clinicians and patients, integrated with EMIS Web and SystmOne clinical systems.
en-US.longDescription: The iPLATO digital Toolbar is a desktop application that integrates with EMIS Web and SystmOne to power secure two-way communication between clinicians and patients. It supports direct patient messaging, automated QOF coding, template customisation, file sharing, video consultations and multi-practice support, and works alongside Selfbook, Patient Questionnaires and Triage.
en-US.name: iPlato toolbar

zh-CN.description: 面向临床医生的安全双向消息与视频会诊工具，与 EMIS Web 和 SystmOne 临床系统集成。
zh-CN.longDescription: iPLATO 数字工具栏是一款桌面应用程序，可与 EMIS Web 和 SystmOne 配合使用，为临床医生与患者之间提供安全、双向的沟通渠道。它支持直接向患者发送消息、自动化 QOF 编码、模板定制、文件共享和视频会诊，并支持多诊所管理，同时与 Selfbook、患者问卷和分诊功能协同工作。
